author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಸ್ವಾಭಿಮಾನದ ಹಂಗು ಸ್ವಾನುಭವಕೊತ್ತೀಯೆ
ದಾಂಭಿಕತೆಯಿರದಿರಲು ಗೆಲುವೆಂದು ಸಹಜ
ಜೋಭದ್ರತನವಿರದ ಸಕ್ರಿಯತೆ ಸಾತತ್ಯ
ಶೋಭೆಯದು ಜೀವನಕೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: You pawn yourself to self-regard, to your own experience;
when there is no pretension, victory is natural;
are the beauty of life, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Don’t be a slave to pride or to your own limited experience. Without pretence, success comes naturally. Steady, energetic effort is life’s real beauty.
